name: hoc/invoice
description: A business-ready invoice HOC for display and print workflows, with issuer/customer sections, invoice metadata, status and payment badges, itemized line table, totals summary, and optional notes/terms blocks. Includes built-in print action with callback override and locale support for internationalized finance pages.
useCases: Admin back-office invoice details with printable line-item breakdowns
SaaS billing pages showing issue date, due date, payment status, and amount due
Operations dashboards rendering B2B invoices with account references and custom notes
Client-facing order receipts with tax, shipping, discounts, and payment method information
